ideas.title: Investigating ICE Misconduct
ideas.description: This story would investigate the killing of Alex Pretti and other incidents involving ICE, to determine if there is a pattern of misconduct by the agency.
questions: What are the circumstances surrounding the killing of Alex Pretti?
Is there a pattern of misconduct by ICE?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a significant issue with ICE, and could lead to reforms or accountability for those responsible.

ideas.title: Uncovering Financial Misconduct

questions: What are the details of the alleged fraud by Robert P. Rubicco?

ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a significant issue with financial misconduct, and could lead to reforms or accountability for those responsible.
